text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Environment Preparation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  prepare-environment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Preinstall tools or dependencies in Copilot's environment
        run: |
          # Example commands to preinstall tools or dependencies
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential git curl wget unzip

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Lint code
        run: npm run lint
```

This workflow sets up a basic environment for preparing the Copilot environment by installing necessary tools and dependencies, running tests, and linting the code. You can customize it further based on your specific requirements.
